items.definition:
to recognize or point out a difference
It's hard to distinguish between the two identical twins.

include
We should incorporate these ideas into our plan.

to come out into view
The sun emerged from behind the clouds.

to keep in good condition
We need to preserve our natural resources.

to limit
We need to restrict access to this area.

to place or locate
The hotel is ideally situated near the beach.

to keep something going
The bridge could not sustain the heavy load.

to find or discover by investigation
Police are trying to trace the owner of the car.

to accept or admit the existence or truth of
He acknowledged his mistake.

to fall down or in
The old building collapsed after the earthquake.

to give all or most of one's time or resources to
She devoted her life to helping others.

control, be superior
The team managed to dominate the game from start to finish.

propose someone for a position
They decided to nominate her for the award.

bring back to original condition
They plan to restore the old building to its former glory.

to explain or make clear by using examples or pictures
The speaker used slides to illustrate his points.

settle or find a solution to (a problem, dispute, or contentious matter)
They hoped to resolve the conflict peacefully.

replace (someone or something) with another
You can substitute honey for sugar in this recipe.

to hug; to accept
She embraced the new challenge with enthusiasm.

to show; to display
The museum will exhibit ancient artifacts.

to force; to inflict
The government decided to impose new taxes.

to become aware of; to understand
He could perceive a faint light in the distance.

to produce or provide
The apple tree yields a lot of fruit every year.

to achieve or complete successfully
We hope to accomplish all our goals this year.

to completely remove or get rid of something
We need to eliminate all errors from the report.

to make someone feel sad; to push down
The bad news began to depress him.

to show or prove to be right or reasonable
Can you justify your decision?

to provide with a motive for doing something
His success motivates others to work harder.

wrestle
The two brothers like to wrestle.

correspond
The numbers on the list correspond to the items in the box.

to fascinate
The magician's tricks always fascinate the audience.

to infect
Viruses can infect computer systems.

to manufacture
The company manufactures cars in Germany.

to give official permission for
The manager must authorize all expenses.

to align or position oneself or something in relation to a specific direction or object
It took him a while to orient himself in the new city.

to develop gradually
Species evolve over millions of years.

to give up or yield
The enemy decided to surrender.

To expect or predict.
We anticipate a busy holiday season.

To comfort someone at a time of grief or disappointment.
She tried to console her friend after the bad news.

To intensify, increase, or further improve the quality, value, or extent of.
This software can enhance the quality of your photos.

To prevent (someone) from progressing, succeeding, or fulfilling something.
It frustrates me when I can't solve a problem.

to defeat or overcome completely; to affect strongly
The task might overwhelm him.

to make a thorough or dramatic change in the form, appearance, or character of
Technology can transform our lives.

evaluate or estimate the nature, ability, or quality of
We need to assess the risks before making a decision.

calculate or reckon (a figure or amount)
The software can compute complex equations in seconds.

utter offensive words; invoke evil upon
He would often curse under his breath when things went wrong.

reign
Queen Victoria reigned for over 60 years.

span
The bridge spans the river.

specialize
She specializes in ancient history.

to state a fact or requirement clearly and precisely
Please specify your preferred delivery date.

to identify the nature of an illness or other problem by examination of the symptoms
The doctor diagnosed her with a cold.

to act in accordance with a wish or command
All employees must comply with safety regulations.

resume (an activity) after an interruption
You need to renew your passport before your trip.

voluntarily leave a job or other position
She decided to resign from her position as CEO.

make or become stronger
Regular exercise will strengthen your muscles.

to stop
The rain ceased after an hour.

to move into position for use
The company plans to deploy new software next month.

to raise to a higher position
The new policy aims to elevate the standard of living.

to take hold of suddenly
The police seized the illegal goods.

to provide space for
The hotel can accommodate up to 200 guests.

to make something active or operative
Press the button to activate the alarm.

to describe the distinctive nature or features of
His honesty characterizes his personality.

to form an idea of the amount, number, or value of; assess
We need to evaluate the risks before proceeding.

start
They decided to initiate a new project.

discuss to reach agreement
They need to negotiate a new contract.
